changeSet.author: cp
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ${schema_name}CUSTOMER DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS customer_email_key;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE ${schema_name}CUSTOMER ADD CONSTRAINT customer_email_key UNIQUE (EMAIL);

changeSet.author: cp
changeSet.sql: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE COALESCE( (SELECT 'ALTER TABLE ${schema_name_full}.CUSTOMER DROP CONSTRAINT "' || tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME || '"' FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS tc JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE kcu ON kcu.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = tc.CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA AND kcu.CONSTRAINT_NAME = tc.CONSTRAINT_NAME WHERE tc.TABLE_SCHEMA = UPPER('${schema_name_full}') AND tc.TABLE_NAME = 'CUSTOMER' AND tc.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE' AND kcu.COLUMN_NAME = 'EMAIL'), 'ALTER TABLE ${schema_name_full}.CUSTOMER DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS CUSTOMER_EMAIL_UNIQUE_ABSENT');

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE ${schema_name_full}.CUSTOMER ADD CONSTRAINT CUSTOMER_EMAIL_KEY UNIQUE (EMAIL);
